subject: Columbus School Renaming Resolution
overview: The Committee of the Whole met to establish the structure, application criteria, selection mechanics, and timeline for an advisory committee tasked with proposing a new name for Columbus Elementary School. Following section-by-section review and extensive public comment, the committee approved the amended advisory committee resolution.

items.title: Opening Remarks and Correspondence Report
items.summary: The committee reviewed correspondence and petitions received regarding the Columbus Elementary School renaming and discussed aligning the process with district policy.

items.title: Public Participation on School Renaming
items.summary: Community members, parents, and residents presented arguments both opposing and supporting the renaming of Columbus Elementary School.

items.title: Advisory Committee Application Form
items.summary: The committee established guidelines and optional demographic categories for the advisory committee application form, setting a release date of March 15.

items.title: School Name Submission Guidelines
items.summary: The committee defined rules for submitting suggested school names, requiring individual submission forms for each proposal and excluding Christopher Columbus as a valid submission.

items.title: Application Deadlines and Vetting Process
items.summary: The committee set an application deadline of April 16 and determined that all submitted name suggestions would be forwarded directly to the advisory committee.

items.title: Columbus Elementary School Staff and Student Involvement
items.summary: The committee agreed to include up to three staff members, the principal, and a high school student on the advisory committee, while encouraging schoolwide student participation in name proposals.

items.title: Advisory Committee Membership and Selection Mechanics
items.summary: The committee established a 23-member voting body for the advisory committee, combining school committee picks, designated school positions, and lottery selections.

items.title: Advisory Committee Work Plan and Final Reporting Deadlines
items.summary: The committee established open meeting requirements, public engagement options, and a target reporting deadline of May 24, with provisions allowing an extension up to July 31.

items.title: Resolution Preamble and Final Approval
items.summary: The committee finalized the resolution text and approved the complete advisory committee resolution as amended.
